# Primary artifacts every niac-go release publishes, checked by the fleet
# release-conformance run (MustardSeedNetworks/.github,
# scripts/check-release-artifacts.py). {version} is the tag without its "v".
# Each line's .sbom.json and .cosign.bundle files, checksums.txt and the
# provenance are required without being listed. Change this file in the same
# PR that changes what .goreleaser.yml publishes.

niac-{version}-darwin-arm64.tar.gz
niac-{version}-linux-amd64.tar.gz
niac-{version}-linux-arm64.tar.gz
niac-{version}-windows-amd64.zip
niac-{version}-windows-arm64.zip
niac_{version}_amd64.deb
niac_{version}_arm64.deb
niac-{version}-1.x86_64.rpm
niac-{version}-1.aarch64.rpm

# The scenario and pack content ships as its own architecture-independent
# package.
niac-content_{version}_all.deb
niac-content-{version}-1.noarch.rpm
